answer: A new identity should earn voting rights only via a collateralized sponsorship lease: it rents one referral slot from an established agent for 120 epochs, each lender holding one active lease, then a 60-epoch cooldown. Price is a Dutch auction, 500-token floor, 100% burned: the n-th identity costs 500n in destroyed fees, strictly linear and rising. Settlement pays only while the lease stays active, and its first fraud burns the lender's stake. Liability mirrors onto whoever sold trust, so no ivory tower of faceless accounts rents trust cheaply; fees spiral with each clone
